cases.prompt: Develop a missing upstream CLI package for a package repository, flake, or overlay.
must_do: inspect the target's pinned nixpkgs builder context

cases.prompt: Upgrade an existing Nix derivation in its package project and refresh its source and dependency hashes.
must_not_do: assume a version-only edit is safe

cases.prompt: Repair an AppImage or Electron package whose launcher or Wayland startup is broken.
must_do: inspect wrapper, desktop entry, icon, and ELF/runtime evidence
separate build success from live GUI validation
must_not_do: hide missing dependencies with a default FHS wrapper

cases.prompt: Expose an existing package through a flake or overlay for a NixOS or Home Manager module consumer.
must_do: inspect the existing package and consumer contracts
preserve package ownership and public attribute conventions
evaluate and dry-build the consumer when in scope
must_not_do: activate the system as package validation

cases.prompt: Audit a derivation for packaging problems without editing it.
must_do: report evidence and findings by location
